chapter.heading: A Call to Worship and Obedience
chapter.v:
Oh come,
let us sing to the Lord! Let us shout joyfully to the Rock of our salvation.

Let us
come before His presence with thanksgiving; Let us shout joyfully to Him with psalms.

For the
Lord is the great God, And the great King above all gods.

In His
hand are the deep places of the earth; The heights of the hills are His also.

The sea
is His, for He made it; And His hands formed the dry land.

Oh come,
let us worship and bow down; Let us kneel before the Lord our Maker.

For He
is our God, And we are the people of His pasture, And the sheep of His hand.Today, if you will hear His voice:

“Do not
harden your hearts, as in the rebellion, As in the day of trial in the wilderness,

When your
fathers tested Me; They tried Me, though they saw My work.

For forty
years I was grieved with that generation, And said, ‘It is a people who go astray in their hearts, And they do not know My ways.’

So I
swore in My wrath,‘They shall not enter My rest.’ ”
